Retain the thin outward upper-right ray and the explicit doubled edges, gaps and points; do not regularize their count or make the broken arrows continuous.

Retain the green trace parallel to the upper dark arc and the green right descending stripe, which the blind grayscale path text omitted. The independent black geometry is adopted with these color and point corrections, excluding the duplicated crossing line and neighboring small-circle fragment.
